Yes… Believing your friend was dead, you grieved as though your heart would burst!

Sorrow is born from a heart that loves others, and it becomes a cry that shakes the soul… That cry became a great power, and granted you a new transformation!

Kotaro… your sorrow has turned to joy. She is alive! Rescue her as quickly as you can!
Thank you… King Stone!

uncertain: U13464-U13477 etc.: さん/ちゃん variants for [HERO4] collapse to the same English since honorifics are dropped.
U13480/U13522: 悲しみの王子 / 怒りの王子 rendered 'Prince of Sorrow' / 'Prince of Wrath' (not in glossary).
U13498: 先輩 rendered 'Senpai' (Kotaro to the elder Riders); could be 'Hongo' etc. but the row has no name.
U13528-U13538: [VAR6] speaker is the Inazuman hero (Zeber, Goro in U13529); 'we rescued' chosen for 救出した (subject dropped, rescuer group).
U13514: 小僧 = Jiro, rendered 'the brat'.
omissions_kept: U13528/U13533/U13537/U13538: 救出した has no explicit subject; rendered 'We' (the speaker plus allies) – could be 'I'.
